form_fields.name: username
form_fields.label: SecretId
form_fields.description: 腾讯云 API 密钥 SecretId。新建时与 SecretKey 一起用于拉取可用地域；编辑已有配置时可直接修改。
form_fields.description_en: Tencent Cloud API SecretId. Used with SecretKey to load available regions; can be changed when editing an existing config.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: SecretKey
form_fields.description: 腾讯云 API 密钥 SecretKey。新建时与 SecretId 一起用于拉取可用地域；编辑已有配置时点击编辑图标可更换。
form_fields.description_en: Tencent Cloud API SecretKey. Used with SecretId to load available regions; click edit to replace it on an existing config.

form_fields.name: region
form_fields.label: 腾讯云地域
form_fields.description: 新建时填写密钥后会自动拉取可用地域；编辑已有配置时未改密钥也可直接刷新。可多选，将采集所选全部地域的资源与监控指标。
form_fields.description_en: Available regions load automatically after keys are filled on create; existing configs can refresh without re-entering keys. Multiple regions can be selected and will all be collected.

widget_props.placeholder: 请选择腾讯云地域（可多选）

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 采集周期
form_fields.description: 单次采集预算与触发周期（单位：秒）。同一值同时作为采集间隔与采集超时：超时则丢弃结果不入库。多地域或云资源较多时可调高（建议 ≥ 300）。
form_fields.description_en: Single value for both collection interval and timeout (seconds). Timed-out results are discarded and not published. Raise if many regions or resources are collected (recommend >= 300).
